intro: Q3 2026 BUY regime upgrade is formally activated (July 2: NFP 119K Goldilocks + SPX/VIX dual gate second confirmation). Long-term framework update: SK Hynix Stop Day 1 ISOLATED (July 3 KST: ₩2,552,000 +10.88%, KOSPI 8,088.34 +5.76%) — conviction RESTORED TO MEDIUM from LOW. The two-session round trip in SK Hynix (July 2 -10.96% / July 3 +10.88%) net -1.24% from July 1 close confirms the Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM narrative was a technical catalyst that is now absorbed, with the HBM4 structural thesis unchanged. China H200 chip restriction potentially easing (DOC/BIS under review) — if confirmed, is the most structurally significant upside catalyst for NVDA since the Blackwell Ultra announcement. BTC at $61,986 is approaching Gate 1 ($62,000) for a potential two-gate re-entry sequence over the July 4 holiday weekend; the post-halving long-term structural thesis is the most constructively positioned it has been in 14 sessions. All other long-term theses unchanged from July 2 framework. Warsh FOMC hawkish hold (no cuts through 2026–2027) remains the primary rate-regime headwind for long-duration growth assets.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.timeframe: 6–12 months (through FY27 earnings cycle; nearest catalyst August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings)
ideas.idea: NVDA is the dominant structural AI infrastructure position with conviction MAINTAINED at HIGH. The Stop Day 1 / Stop Day 2 binary (July 6 close determination) is a short-term tactical event — the long-term Blackwell Ultra / sovereign AI capex thesis is entirely unchanged. Half-size from July 1 ($200.09) held; full-size add conditional on July 7 open (>$200 + SPX >7,460 + VIX <17 simultaneously). EMERGING CATALYST: China H200 chip restriction potentially easing per DOC/BIS rulemaking under review — if confirmed, removes the single largest near-term overhang on NVDA China revenue ($7–10B annualized), structurally expanding the TAM beyond the current restricted-export baseline. August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings ($91B guide) is the fundamental re-rating event regardless of short-term gate sequencing.
ideas.why: Blackwell Ultra (GB300 NVL72 = 1.5x GB200 performance) is shipping; sovereign AI capex from EU, Japan, Saudi Arabia, UAE is confirmed at $100B+ combined at heads-of-state level; NVDA's CUDA software moat requires 18–24 months to replicate, which AMD and Intel cannot close in FY27. Switching cost is structural. Every major hyperscaler (MSFT Azure, GOOGL Cloud, AWS, META) committed multi-year NVDA GPU purchases in Q1 2026 earnings calls — these are not cancellable on short-term sentiment. China H200 reopening (if confirmed) adds $7–10B back to NVDA's addressable China market, which is not modeled in current Street estimates — the upside revision would be the single largest positive catalyst of Q3 2026.
ideas.driver: China H200 restriction easing (emerging catalyst — DOC/BIS under review); Blackwell B300 GPU ramp H2 2026 expanding compute density 3x vs H100; sovereign AI capex ($100B+ combined) confirmed; inference demand scaling faster than training as AI moves from development to deployment; Q2 FY27 earnings August 26 ($91B guide confirmation); Rubin architecture roadmap (2027) extending competitive moat
ideas.risk: Stop Day 2 triggers on July 6 US close (mandatory exit July 7 — short-term forced selling, not fundamental change); China H200 reopening report proves premature or denied; AMD MI400 achieves competitive CUDA-equivalent software ecosystem within 12 months; hyperscaler AI capex cuts in H1 2027 if AI monetization disappoints; FOMC rate hold through 2028 compresses 35x forward multiple

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.timeframe: 3–6 months (through Q4 FY26 earnings September 2026; structural 12–18 months through HBM4 supercycle)
ideas.idea: MU is the most compelling near-term AI semi structural buy and conviction is MAINTAINED at HIGH. The Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM narrative (primary July 2 catalyst for Korean semiconductor stress) is a MICRON POSITIVE: every mobile DRAM market share point Apple gives to CXMT (Pentagon 1260H blacklisted) means US government AI procurement must use DoD-compliant HBM — Micron's Idaho fab is the only US-manufactured HBM4 at scale. $50B Q4 FY26 guide (+40% above prior consensus) is already confirmed; HBM4 sold out through 2026; no stop protocol overhang; no ADR mechanics. July 6 open creates the first post-holiday tactical entry at $1,150–$1,200.
ideas.why: The CXMT/YMTC blacklist amplification thesis is underappreciated by the Street: DoD AI procurement mandates specifically require US-manufactured memory, and CXMT's blacklist status makes Chinese DRAM non-compliant for the entire US government AI pipeline. Every Micron HBM4 wafer coming out of the Idaho CHIPS Act fab is DoD-compliant by jurisdiction of manufacture — CXMT cannot replicate this. Samsung $226B AI data center commitment validates Micron's $50B Q4 guide at national-government scale. The HBM market structural oligopoly (Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron) enforces pricing discipline — no fourth entrant can reach HBM4 EUV production at commercial scale in the next 24 months.
ideas.driver: HBM4 ramp through H2 2026 ($50B Q4 FY26 guide sets FY27 at $200B+ revenue run rate); CHIPS Act Idaho fab cost advantage vs. Korean competitors; DoD AI procurement mandate for US-manufactured HBM (amplified by Apple/CXMT/YMTC Pentagon blacklist); September Q4 FY26 earnings confirmation of HBM demand cycle duration; oligopolistic HBM pricing discipline (3-player market)
ideas.risk: HBM demand cycle peaks H1 2027 earlier than expected as AI model efficiency gains (sparse attention, quantization) reduce memory per compute unit; Samsung aggressive HBM4 pricing to defend NVIDIA share; Q4 FY26 guide miss at September earnings (largest single downside risk); China export controls expand to remove DRAM export channel; Micron yield issues at sub-10nm EUV node

ideas.name: SK Hynix
ideas.timeframe: 3–9 months (through ADR seasoning, Q3 2026 earnings August, HBM4 demand cycle through H1 2027)
ideas.idea: SK Hynix conviction RESTORED TO MEDIUM from LOW: Stop Day 1 isolated (July 3 KST: ₩2,552,000 +10.88%); KOSPI +5.76% confirms Korean macro is stabilizing; ADR listing July 10 (SKHY, Nasdaq, $29.4B) on track with 5 KRX sessions remaining. The two-session round trip (-10.96% July 2 / +10.88% July 3 = net -1.24% from July 1 close) confirms the Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM catalyst has been absorbed without structural HBM4 damage. Long-term framework holds at medium conviction with two gates still required for full-size add (KOSPI >8,500 AND SK Hynix >₩2,700,000 simultaneously). The ADR listing creates a new structural catalyst: post-SKHY-listing MSCI World index inclusion process and US institutional demand for the only liquid USD-denominated SK Hynix instrument.
ideas.why: SK Hynix's ~70% HBM4 revenue from AI data centers (NVDA Blackwell exclusive supply partner) is entirely unaffected by Apple's CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM negotiations. The structural thesis — world's largest HBM3e/HBM4 supplier, NVDA Blackwell B300 partner, $29.4B Nasdaq ADR listing July 10 — is unchanged. The ADR underwriter ceiling at ₩2,723,000 (July 3 intraday high) is only ₩23,000 above Gate 2 (₩2,700,000) — the two levels are converging as the July 10 listing approaches, suggesting the ADR offering price is being managed near or above Gate 2. Post-listing MSCI World inclusion process (typically 2–3 quarters post-listing for a $29.4B stock) creates systematic demand that will not be present before the listing.
ideas.driver: July 10 Nasdaq ADR listing (SKHY, $29.4B) — post-listing MSCI World index inclusion process; HBM4 ramp as primary NVIDIA Blackwell B300 supplier; Q3 2026 earnings (August) confirming HBM4 ASP premium over HBM3e; KOSPI ADR-listing-driven institutional reallocation; Gate clearance (KOSPI >8,500 AND SK Hynix >₩2,700,000 simultaneously) enabling full-size add
ideas.risk: Apple/CXMT/YMTC negotiations confirmed as done deal over July 4 weekend — market re-prices mobile DRAM risk more severely; new Stop Day 1 triggered (any FUTURE KST close below ₩2,540,000) before ADR listing; KOSPI macro deterioration (CPI 3.2%, BOK hawkish, KRW weakness) prevents Gate 1 (>8,500) from clearing; NVDA supply diversification toward Samsung if HBM4 yield improves unexpectedly; ADR listing price below ₩2,700,000 ceiling signals underwriter retreat

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.idea: Microsoft is the most diversified AI monetization play with the strongest rate resilience in the big-tech complex. Azure AI cloud (OpenAI partnership exclusive enterprise deployment), Copilot productivity suite (400M+ 365 commercial seats at $30/month premium), GitHub Copilot (developer workflow capture). FOMC Warsh hawkish hold through 2027–2028 pressures growth multiples, but MSFT's $100B+ FCF and ~2% dividend yield provide a valuation floor that pure-growth AI names lack. Q3 BUY regime upgrade confirms the enterprise AI adoption tailwind — Copilot seat expansion is the primary revenue driver in 2026. No Korea semiconductor exposure. No SPCX bond distribution mechanics.
ideas.why: Enterprise AI adoption in 2026 is about Copilot seat conversion, not new product launches. 400M+ commercial 365 seats converting at 10–20% to Copilot Premium at $30/month = 2.5x revenue per seat vs. base tier. Azure AI workloads are sticky: switching cost is 12–24 months of enterprise IT re-integration. Goldilocks NFP + US BUY regime = enterprise IT budget cycle continues expanding through FY27. OpenAI exclusivity for enterprise Azure fine-tuning creates a 3–5 year switching friction moat. MSFT's $100B+ FCF floor means even a multiple compression from 32x to 25x forward leaves intrinsic value intact.
ideas.driver: Copilot monetization at scale (400M+ 365 commercial seats, 10–20% Copilot Premium penetration at $30/month); Azure AI revenue compounding at 35%+ YoY through FY27; GitHub Copilot Enterprise expansion; sovereign AI infrastructure licensing (EU, Middle East); $100B+ FCF floor providing rate-resilient valuation support in Warsh hawkish hold environment
ideas.risk: OpenAI explores independent cloud or direct enterprise relationships (partnership deteriorates); Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude 5 captures enterprise AI at lower price point; FOMC rate hold through 2028 compresses MSFT multiple from 32x to 25x forward; EU AI Act compliance burden exceeds $5B; enterprise IT spending cuts if US macro deteriorates past Goldilocks

ideas.name: Meta Platforms
ideas.idea: META carries the highest long-term conviction of any big-tech name on a risk-adjusted basis. The most direct AI-to-revenue conversion path in the portfolio: every AI ad targeting improvement reaches 3.3B daily active users in real-time without enterprise sales cycles, semiconductor sourcing complexity, or regulatory AI Act enforcement lag. Goldilocks NFP (119K) confirms the US consumer employment backdrop for sustained ad spend. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) is the first full-AI-feature quarter at scale. FCF $60B+ annual makes META the most rate-resistant large-cap AI name in a Warsh hawkish hold environment — no US equity stock provides this combination of AI monetization velocity and FCF floor simultaneously. Convention MAINTAINED at HIGH.
ideas.why: 3.3B daily active users is an unassailable data and distribution moat for AI training and deployment that no competitor can close in 18–24 months. META's Zuckerberg AI personal assistant is the first consumer AI product with genuine distribution at scale — every improvement reaches 3.3B users immediately. The monetization feedback loop has zero lag. Apple/CXMT has ZERO impact on META's revenue model. Korea shock has ZERO impact on META's revenue model. The stock is insulated from semiconductor cycle risk, Korean market dynamics, and most geopolitical trade conflicts. This makes META uniquely valuable in a portfolio exposed to AI semi risk through NVDA, MU, and SK Hynix.
ideas.driver: AI ad efficiency compounding at 3.3B user scale (CPM expansion); LLaMA 4 open-source flywheel building developer ecosystem lock-in and monetization; AR/AI glasses integration (Ray-Ban Meta) approaching hardware/software platform status; Q2 2026 earnings (late July) first AI-at-scale quarter; FCF $60B+ annual providing rate-resilient floor under any reasonable Warsh scenario
ideas.risk: Apple iOS ATT 3.0 (hypothetical) restricts cross-app tracking further; EU AI Act discriminatory compliance costs exceed $3B; ad recession in H2 2026 if US employment deteriorates past Goldilocks (not base case); AI Reality Labs losses exceed $20B/year offsetting core FCF; Zuckerberg AI assistant privacy litigation in EU or US

The holiday weekend (US markets closed July 3–6) removes institutional selling pressure from crypto markets that trade continuously — the gate confirmation sequence may complete over the holiday weekend. LONG-TERM CONVICTION MAINTAINED at MEDIUM.

At $61,986 in a post-halving supply-shock regime with ascending daily lows (July 1 $57,802 → July 2 $59,584 → July 3 $61,232), the medium-term risk/reward remains asymmetric on the long side. The IBIT flow reversal is the leading indicator for the next institutional leg — watch Gate 1/2 UTC midnight close confirmations.

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.timeframe: 3–12 months (through September 2 first earnings; December 9 lock-up expiry as structural anchor)
ideas.idea: SPCX carries the most binary long-term structural optionality in the portfolio. Step-aside tactical posture is UNCHANGED at HIGH conviction (bond distribution Day 8 complete, volume ~52M, clearance est. July 9–11, re-entry gate $185). Long-term structural thesis: September 2 first post-IPO earnings (Starlink ARR, Starship revenue, Cursor AI $500M+ threshold, Starshield classified contracts) is the fundamental anchoring event. The $148–$165 accumulation window may be the 2026 structural entry zone — every bond distribution session above $150 IG floor preserves the re-entry optionality. Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 (~$4.3B passive) adds structural index demand that permanently embeds SPCX in QQQ/QQQM systematic flows. Korea shock has ZERO direct impact on SpaceX fundamentals (Starlink, Starship, Cursor AI are domestic US revenue stories). SpaceX IPO optionality (rumored 2026–2027 SpaceX equity listing following SPCX as the IPO pioneer) makes SPCX the primary retail liquid vehicle for SpaceX structural exposure.
ideas.why: Space infrastructure is at the same inflection that cloud computing crossed in 2012–2014: cost curves have collapsed (Falcon 9 250+ reflights, Starship development cost-per-orbit declining 90%+ vs prior generation) but revenue generation is in commercial innings 1–2. Starlink is profitable. SpaceX DoD backlog is $10B+. Cursor AI coding assistant crosses the $500M ARR threshold for first-earnings disclosure. The December 9 lock-up expiry (180-day IPO lock-up: float +4% → 9–14%) creates a structural supply ceiling at $185–$200 before and after September 2 earnings — this is why the $185 re-entry gate is the minimum requirement: you need confirmed demand before the lock-up supply arrives in December.
ideas.driver: Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 (~$4.3B QQQ/QQQM systematic demand permanently embedded); bond distribution clearance est. July 9–11 (re-entry gate $185 activation post-clearance); September 2 first post-IPO earnings (Starlink ARR, Starship revenue recognition, Cursor AI $500M+ confirmation, Starshield classified contracts disclosed); SpaceX equity IPO optionality (2026–2027) creating retail demand for the only liquid public SpaceX vehicle; $150 IG floor institutional bid providing structural floor
ideas.risk: December 9 lock-up expiry (float +4% → 9–14%) creates supply ceiling near $185 re-entry gate — every approach risks insider distribution; Korea-shock contagion causes July 6 US open IG floor breach ($150) → framework reassessment required; Nasdaq 100 inclusion demand (Day 10) absorbed intraday (Russell 1000 June 26 template repeats), delaying $185 re-entry gate; Starship launch failure or Starlink latency incident before September 2 earnings; SpaceX IPO delayed to 2028+; bond distribution second wave develops post-clearance
